summary: Final v0.3 OpenCode acceptance passed in the isolated Crew state. The target branch was pulled at source commit 9afad0a82d1eaa01e37dbd7d3f0ccef39dc2886a. Deterministic validation passed (426/426 tests, client build, policy probe), the live policy matrix passed 15/15, genuine OpenCode-backed MCP workers completed with sanitized provider/model selection traces, live concurrency/session activation and adaptive routing evidence passed, and a bounded policy rejection propagated as SUBAGENTS_DISABLED with normalized POLICY_REJECTED classification. Official Harness health and five non-secret ~/.dsh metadata/hash checks were unchanged. Crew was exercised through isolated install/status/uninstall and reinstalled only in Crew-owned state; no executor secret was persisted.

tests.name: Task contract validation
tests.evidence: node .agent-workflow/validator/validate-contract.mjs task docs/agent-tasks/ACTIVE_TASK.json -> VALID TASK CONTRACT (exit 0).

tests.name: Client build
tests.evidence: pnpm run build:client exited 0; the generated tracked lib/client.js was restored to the source revision and is absent from the completion diff.

tests.name: Policy probe
tests.evidence: node scripts/policy-probe.mjs -> 13/13 checks passed, including effective policy reporting, disabled dispatch, tier clamp, manual semantics, and reset.

tests.name: Live schema-v3 policy matrix
tests.evidence: node scripts/live-policy-matrix.mjs printed all 15 checks PASS, including review-pipeline I1 and I1b; the temporary fixture and completed background jobs were cleaned up.

tests.name: Crew Hub compatibility and catalog readiness
tests.evidence: Crew-owned Hub port 3210 returned runtime compatibility HTTP 200 and the live catalog returned HTTP 200 with 4 providers and 9 models. Readiness reported hub_compatibility PASS and provider_catalog PASS; info-only NOT_RUN rows remained non-failing.

tests.name: Genuine OpenCode-backed MCP worker
tests.evidence: A real MCP workflow completed in an isolated worktree with outcome success and tests PASS. Child attempt evidence selected provider opencode-alt, model deepseek-v4-flash, source priority, with a sanitized selection_trace and no sensitive fields. A separate Pro session workflow selected deepseek-v4-pro and also completed with tests PASS.

tests.name: Live max_parallel and activation boundaries
tests.evidence: Three genuine workloads showed max_parallel=1 admission with queued jobs; raising to 2 admitted a second running job, lowering to 1 left both active jobs running and retained the queued job. A next-workflow session override changed the effective default to Pro, exposed documented next-workflow/next-session boundaries, and completed using the Pro OpenCode model; reset returned balanced/Flash defaults.

tests.name: Live adaptive routing
tests.evidence: With adaptive enabled, automatic candidates first reported INSUFFICIENT_HISTORY, then HEALTH_REORDERED after bounded Crew-observed failures and selected opencode-alt for successful workers. The trace recorded warming/mature samples, scores, ordered candidates, and applied=true. Explicit priority remained authoritative with EXPLICIT_PRIORITY and source priority. Restarting the isolated Hub reset all candidate samples to zero and returned to INSUFFICIENT_HISTORY.

tests.name: Bounded failure propagation and normalized classification
tests.evidence: A live MCP dispatch-disabled probe returned machine code SUBAGENTS_DISABLED; the MCP client surfaced failure.category=policy, reason_code=POLICY_REJECTED, and source_code=SUBAGENTS_DISABLED. Raw error text was not used for classification or persisted in the Result Contract.

tests.name: Isolated install/status/uninstall and final reinstall
tests.evidence: Status reported the Crew plugin installed only in the dedicated dsh-crew profile. Real uninstall removed the Crew-owned registration offline and status then reported not installed. Final offline Crew-owned link installation restored the plugin; final status reported DSH plugin installed while Codex and Claude integrations remained not installed. The direct package-manager installer path was bounded by its release-age policy, so the supported offline Crew-owned fallback was used without changing repository files.

tests.name: Official Harness health and persistent-state integrity
tests.evidence: Official web Harness on port 3080 returned HTTP 200 before and after acceptance. Non-secret bytes/SHA-256 metadata for .credentials.yaml (208), settings.yaml (1332), profiles/web/package.json (185), cordis.yml (223), and pnpm-lock.yaml (115) matched exactly before/after. Credential contents were never read, printed, copied, or modified.

tests.name: Executor secret handling
tests.evidence: Already-configured ZCode-local OpenCode provider keys were injected transiently into the isolated Hub process only. Crew state contains provider env references, not secret values; no OpenCode API-key value was written to repository files or this Result Contract.

tests.name: Standalone DeepSeek Official applicability
tests.evidence: Legitimate SKIP on this executor: DEEPSEEK_API_KEY was absent from the process environment, so scripts/smoke-real.mjs standalone exited with its documented blocked result without reading official credential files.

tests.name: macOS smoke applicability
tests.evidence: Legitimate SKIP because the executor is Windows, not macOS.

tests.name: Final isolated state
tests.evidence: Crew remains installed only in Crew-owned DSH_HOME/profile state with Hub port 3210; the official web profile and official Harness remain separate and healthy. No tracked repository file other than this Result Contract was changed before completion cleanup.
